# Thermodynamics and CS

#### Entropy

What is entropy?

How does it relate to disorder in a closed system?

:::

A measure of the number of microstates corresponding to a macrostate.

It tends to increase in isolated systems according to the second law.
<!--anki-id: 37f5ab6f-9550-4cf9-8711-96058d755e97-->




#### Depth-First Search

What is DFS?

When is it preferred over BFS?

:::

Depth-first search explores as far as possible along each branch before backtracking.

It uses less memory than BFS on deep graphs when the tree depth is large.
<!--anki-id: 23fd765e-61fe-477d-9186-398401744cf4-->




#### TCP Protocol

What is TCP?

:::

Transmission Control Protocol.

It provides reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of bytes between applications.
<!--anki-id: 081d7e01-9eff-40ec-9832-51ff827c8ade-->
